commit.message: feat(loop-control): kill-switch guard across the unattended-merge chain + EMERGENCY STOP/RESUME

intent: PR-B of the walking-mode loop-closure plan (docs/plans/GRAPH_OF_LOOPS_DESIGN_2026-07-29.md, operator ruling 2026-07-29): one-tap EMERGENCY STOP/RESUME workflows writing docs/ops/loop_control/KILLSWITCH on the loop-control branch, plus a fail-closed kill-switch guard as the first step of every unattended-merge chain workflow (automerge, router, backlog).

negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import subprocess,sys; from pathlib import Path; p=Path('.github/workflows/automerge.yml'); orig=p.read_text(); mut=orig.replace('Halt on loop kill-switch','DISABLED-guard',1); assert mut!=orig; p.write_text(mut); r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pytest','tests/test_loop_killswitch_workflows.py','-q'],check=False); p.write_text(orig); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode!=0 else 2)"
negative_controls.name: guard-removal-breaks-contract-test

honest_blockers: Guard behavior is string/structure-pinned by tests/test_loop_killswitch_workflows.py; live halt behavior is only provable after operator hand-merge, by dispatching loop-emergency-stop and observing the chain workflows go red with HALTED BY KILLSWITCH.

This PR touches surfaces owned by merge-master-mike-d4-2026-06 while the walking-mode plan files under loop-closure-2026-06; the packet binds to the owning track and the operator adjudicates at hand-merge.
Tier 2 under the 2026-07-29 ruling: this PR must never be auto-merged; draft until operator hand-merge.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the single commit. The chain workflows lose the guard and return to prior unattended behavior; loop-emergency-stop/loop-resume disappear; any existing loop-control branch state becomes inert.
